title: wslua: re-enable debugger during Lua reload
description:
Restore debugger state before wslua_init(), drop the delayed
reload-done path, and clean up obsolete reload bookkeeping.

Avoid report_failure() when debugger handled the error.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes
